risk_note: RV2 (admin, audit only; no money moved). Transactional system audit (rulings D10-551 ②, D10-552): migrations make audit_logs.admin_id nullable with a system_actor column and CHECKs (exactly one of them; format), NOT VALID then validated; the ban-drop-not-null ignore is justified because audit_logs is neither a funds table nor partitioned and its foreign key is MATCH SIMPLE. The adapter writes one row on the caller's transaction only, action order_auto_hold, so it commits or rolls back with the hold. Reads, filters and exports map system rows; rows of console accounts are field-for-field unchanged; a system row is never credited to an account and is hidden without audit.view_all. Production assembly belongs to B1-09n. Full verification by the required CI checks (04:16 general rule). Frozen integration tests of the touched modules (spec/admin, spec/db/admin, orders admin-hold and admin-mounts) run locally: 60 files, 855 tests pass.
